items.headline: 49ers' Nick Bosa set to face Rams; George Kittle 'looks good'
items.description: All signs point toward San Francisco's Nick Bosa and George Kittle playing in Thursday's season opener versus the Rams.

items.headline: Aaron Donald pleased with progress as Rams' opener nears
items.description: After two seasons out of football, defensive lineman Aaron Donald, 35, has been pleasantly surprised by how his body has reacted since rejoining the Los Angeles Rams last month, telling reporters on Monday that he is "feeling good. Feeling really good."

items.headline: Niners' head coach Kyle Shanahan expects to be playing against Donald in week 1
items.description: Sarah Barshop provides the latest update on Aaron Donald ahead of Week 1 of the NFL season.

items.headline: 2026 NFL season sim: Predictions, surprises, playoff teams
items.description: We played out one of the Football Power Index's 10,000 season simulations (No. 9,187), from Week 1 through Super Bowl LXI.

items.headline: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan expects Rams' Aaron Donald to play Thu.
items.description: The Rams haven't made a decision on whether Aaron Donald will play in the season opener against the 49ers, but San Francisco coach Kyle Shanahan said he has no doubt the defensive tackle will be out there.

items.headline: Rams expect Puka Nacua, Alaric Jackson to play vs. 49ers
items.description: The Rams do not expect wide receiver Puka Nacua and left tackle Alaric Jackson to be suspended for the season opener against the 49ers despite ongoing legal situations, head coach Sean McVay said.
